content:
felix: Heads-up \/ AtlasCredit wants a 48h migration POC to validate parity with their current vendor. Key asks: identical JSON surface (field names + nested schema), same retry semantics on callbacks, and predictable billing. They also want SCIM support for provisioning during the POC.

norma: Noted. Their current API posts final results to /notify with headers X-ACCT-ID and X-Req; they expect meta.tokens_used in the response and an idempotency-key on retries. I can add a shim to preserve those fields exactly.

chad: Parity plan: 1) run 1500 canonical Q&A prompts through both endpoints, 2) compute token counts under both tokenizers, 3) run embedding similarity + pass@1 checks for answer equivalence, 4) flag >12% semantic variance. Will need a dedicated small pool for deterministic runs (ETA ~20h).

irene: Product caveat  our function-calling schema differs slightly (we return choices[0].function_call vs their vendor uses result.func). Recommend we alias to their keys for the POC and note differences in the eval report. Also watch that our default stop tokens can alter answer endings.

kevin: Security asks: mTLS for outgoing callbacks, SCIM for provisioning, allowlisted egress CIDRs, and a copy of our SOC2 subreport. They also asked for KMS-wrapped logs. I sent them the questionnaire link and requested their SAML\/SP metadata for SSO.

legal: AtlasCredit requests a POC addendum: 21-day retention and explicit non-use for model training. We can do 21 days but need to confirm purge automation and signer. Also they want a limited SLA during the POC window.

felix: Action items: @norma implement field aliases + idempotency header; @chad run paired runs and produce multiplier + equivalence report; @irene alias function_call keys and document decoding caveats; @kevin send SOC2 and egress IPs; @legal draft POC addendum. Atlas contact: integrations@atlascredit.com.

chad: Smoke curl I'll use (replace API_KEY):

```
curl -X POST https:\/\/proxy.redwood.dev\/atlas\/qa \
  -H "X-ACCT-ID: atlas-poc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application\/json" \
  -d '{"question":"Explain the chargeback policy for merchant X","idempotency_key":"abc-123","options":{"max_tokens":200,"temperature":0}}'
```

Proxy will rewrite to \/v1\/qa and return their expected schema: {"id","result":{"text"},"meta":{"tokens_used"}} for parity.

irene: For tighter parity we should run with temperature=0 and deterministic seeds. Also document that quantized model variants may change token counts; call that out in the report.

kevin: Netops egress CIDRs: 3.101.44.0\/24, 52.19.200.0\/24. SOC2 excerpt uploaded: SOC2_excerpt_redwood.pdf. Sent to AtlasSec. Waiting on their SCIM \/ SAML metadata.

legal: Drafting the 21-day POC addendum and limited SLA clause. Who will sign on Atlas side? Please confirm contact.

ops-bot: staging-atlas-poc env provisioned region=us-east-1 size=dedicated-small

deploy-bot: deploy started: branch=atlas/compat-proxy build=802 ETA=6m :rocket:

felix: Two risks to call out in the demo: (1) token billing will likely not be 1:1; show multiplier and reconcile approach, (2) function-calling key differences  well alias but call out long-term mapping issues. If security or legal stalls >24h, escalate to AE. :thumbsup:
